summary_bullets: Treat submodule edit bails as permanent Step 2 inline-recovery cases instead of retryable dispatch failures
Clarify that only later rebase checkpoints are prompt-side Bash invocations
Reuse the scout manifest filter for review pre-scout normalization while allowing review-mode static slugs
commit_message:
Handle submodule edit bails and review scout filtering

Classify submodule-edit-required-out-of-scope as a permanent Step 2 inline-recovery class with retry-policy and regression coverage.

Clarify the rebase checkpoint macro now that 1.r routing arrives through the Step 0 bootstrap envelope.

Generalize scout manifest filtering for review mode and delegate review pre-scout normalization to the shared Python helper.
